scope: Validate MPOLYGON DXF group 99, the number of degenerate boundary paths, at the reader and typed-writer admission boundaries.

sourceWitness.reader: DRW_MPolygon::parseCode currently assigns group 99 directly to degenerateLoops without checking its domain.
sourceWitness.completion: DRW_MPolygon::validateDxf currently omits degenerateLoops, so processMPolygon can publish a negative value to the callback.
sourceWitness.writer: dxfRW::preflightEntity rejects negative degenerateLoops, but does not apply the existing bounded item-count policy.
sourceWitness.autodeskDefinition: Group 99 is the count of degenerate boundary paths, defined as borders ignored by the hatch. The documentation does not establish a relation to group 91's retained path count or a format-specific numerical maximum.

implementationBrief.parserRule: Require a nonnegative count within the existing kMaxHatchItems budget before assigning degenerateLoops.
implementationBrief.writerRule: Require the same bounded count in DRW_MPolygon::validateDxf so reader and writer admission agree.
implementationBrief.doNotInfer: Do not require group 99 to be less than or equal to group 91; Autodesk does not document that relation. Do not advertise semantic support from this scalar-domain check.

validationPlan: Generated in-memory parser controls for negative, over-budget and valid group 99 values; invalid records preserve model state and permit corrected retry.
Typed writer admission refuses negative and over-budget values and accepts a valid positive count without mutating the destination on refusal.
Build only the affected fixture executable; run the owning selector and affected MPOLYGON cohort.

verifiedBehavior: Negative and over-budget reader values do not mutate the typed model; corrected group-99 values parse and validate.
The count ceiling 10000 is accepted; 10001 is refused.
Typed writer refusal preserves existing destination bytes for negative and over-budget counts; the same writer then emits a valid count and typed readback returns group 99 value 3.
Existing MPOLYGON fill-CMC, inactive-gradient transaction, and metadata/boundary readback controls pass.

fixtures.testInput: Locally generated in-memory DXF group records and typed objects.

repositoryState.inputSnapshot: staged group-99-only blobs composed from HEAD; fast CTest cohort ran against corresponding worktree source
